name: lomesearch
description: A privacy-first browser with its own local search engine

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @lomesearch/engine && npm run build --workspace @lomesearch/browser
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @lomesearch/engine && npm run typecheck --workspace @lomesearch/browser
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @lomesearch/engine && npm run test --workspace @lomesearch/browser
